name: Sign Out Generated Proxy
summary: Binds the canonical sign-out endpoint to the generated AuthClient operation used by both stable web and mobile clients.

sourceReferences.note: Generated AuthClient.createSignout calls POST /api/auth/signout with SignOutRequest.
Angular sign-out uses the generated createSignout operation for the authenticated cookie session.
React Native sign-out reads the stored current refresh token, sends it through generated createSignout, and clears local session state only after server success.
